_about: The three approved Shorts shown in landing-D scenes 4-5: this product's own output (app.clipper, run by the showcase
workflow), web-encoded by .github/workflows/landing-film.yml (job 'shorts') into saas/web/static/media/d/. Assets for
this project's own website only. Each source is the showcase artifact's file, checked against the sha256 of the copy
the owner approved (content/site-previews/D/shorts/). Titles are the pipeline's own AI titles (result.json); credits
come from docs/saas/landing-d-sources.md for the working-copy range each clip covers. Yellow word captions are the
product's real caption style, burned in by the renderer: they are output, not page chrome.
